_comment: The eight Augmented Nature MCP servers used in the paper's live runs, pinned to the commits that were built and run (verified with git rev-parse HEAD in the checkouts used for the paper). They are NOT vendored in this repository; servers/setup_servers.{sh,ps1} clones and builds them. 'tools_advertised' is the per-server count of Table 1, re-measured via MCP ListTools by scripts/run_live.py on 2026-09-27 (identical). LICENCE CHANGE UPSTREAM: on 2025-12-21, after every pinned commit, Augmented Nature replaced the licence of all eight repositories with a custom one permitting personal, non-commercial use only and prohibiting redistribution and modification without permission. The pinned commits predate that change. This is recorded as a fact, not legal advice.
